notes.title: River City Three Kingdom Next: soundtrack, chapters and new characters
notes.content:
■ Discover the soundtrack!

The soundtrack designed to enhance the atmosphere of the game has been released. You can enjoy the game's BGM in advance, and it can be used as perfect music to listen to while studying or working. The BGM collection can be viewed on YouTube following this link or below.

[previewyoutube=SwWdwrv-Z5I;full][/previewyoutube]

■ The story finale
The story begins immediately after the Battle of Red Cliffs and continues through the famous climax of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, the Battle of Wuzhang Plains. More than 100 humorous and action-packed Kunio characters appear, and laughter and passionate battles unfold. In each chapter, players will be able to experience a mix of strategy and drama.

Chapter 1: Journey of a Thousand Miles
After giving their all in the Battle of Red Cliffs, Liu Bei and his men were taking a break in Gong’An. However, due to Zhuge Liang's schemes, they began to fight over Jingzhou and start solidifying their foothold.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111414/03cfb05c64d2ce793d6427a932b660e3852d88da.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111414/7eed41206442b30211f88a8910b0a094496e6607.png

Chapter 2: A Kingdom Divided by Three
Having established a base in Jingzhou, Liu Bei and his men are invited by an envoy from Yizhou to provide reinforcements. However, due to various incidents along the way, Liu Bei ends up taking control of Yizhou. Leading to the founding of the Three Kingdoms.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111414/2675aa19417126e48590996088b1849c56709c69.png　{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111414/6ff43c3b465c3fe81b933c00103fbd5ae4bd5452.png
Chapter 3: Cloudy Sky, Impending Danger
Guan Yu alone defends Jingzhou as to repel Cao Cao. The allied forces of Wei and Wu unite against him, and Guan Yu escapes from a certain death. Liu Bei is furious at the betrayal of Wu, who were allies up until now...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111414/903b6cf498f924ab45a76de5cd6e4a18e4539cb9.png　{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111414/080008043f927b1ca70b1363e7a3bc062145cb03.png
Chapter 4: Seven Captives, Seven Released
Having re-established an alliance with Wu, Liu Bei and his men advance into the "Nanman region" in the south of Yi Province to control a reported insurrection. The jungle there is completely different from anything they had experienced before...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111414/4e793ab4b915c26e7637baa5b22433abf15b16a7.png　{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111414/7c56a9f85e800b84d4386667e2f97bc254e4412f.png
Chapter 5: A Crisis in Fall
Liu Bei and his men are finally facing an all-out confrontation with Wei. They leave Hanzhong and advance deep into Wei territory, occupying it, but a mistake from Ma Su puts them in a difficult position after the Battle of Jieting.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111414/0421074ffb4441022c4b5574b7fb500070b46e75.png　{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111414/a5a8627d808028444df1e137336a2369a4b05da4.png
Chapter 6: Hot-blooded Eternity
Liu Bei and his men continue their northern expeditions, and in the Battle of Wuzhang Plains they face off against the genius strategist of Wei, Sima Yi. What would Sima Yi's final plan lead to ? What could be hidden in Chang'an? The finale of River City Saga: Three Kingdoms!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111414/5f20b61aecdf3a796954e411bb6c8c0ea141786a.png　{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111414/f902e8d96c5e3d74a90fc5133414263b724f35d5.png

■New characters!
New characters continue appearing one after another to liven up the story! Heroes from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, drawn in Kunio's style, will join the story with their own unique personalities.

Wei Yan (Kumada)
Ma Liang (Minori)
Lu Meng (Wataru)
Sima Shi (RK300-1)

will be joining the already massive roster.
